newsitem.title: UK: Capital Intelligence adjusts five Korea banks.
newsitem.headline: Capital Intelligence adjusts five Korea banks.

text.p: Cyprus-based Capital Intelligence said it had adjusted the ratings or outlooks of five major South Korean banks.
In a statement on Monday, the rating agency said Korea's First Bank's long-term rating was reduced to BB plus from BBB minus. The short term rating was maintained at A2 and the outlook as negative.
SeoulBank's long term rating was reduced to BB plus from BBB minus, and the short term rating to A3 from A2. The bank's negative outlook was maintained.
Commercial Bank of Korea's long term rating was cut to BBB minus from BBB, short term rating remained A2 and a stable outlook was assigned.
The long term rating of Cho Hung Bank was lowered to A minus from A while its short term rating was maintained at A minus and a stable outlook was assigned.

It reaffirmed the ratings of Hanil Bank at A long term, and A1 short term in view of its superior asset quality. But Capital Intelligence assigned a negative outlook to the bank to reflect the likely effect of the poor economic climate.
